payload.summary: Jim handed six UI cleanup asks (AFK until all are done, reviews at the end): (1) more padding between the brown rail and edge UI — Discard, Shoe, Panda, Dragon, Bankroll, Deal; (2) three action buttons Clear/Rebet/2x then Deal; (3) 2x doubles the current bet, or takes the last bet when the layout is empty; (4) tray spacing lopsided — big gap bankroll-to-chips, small gap chips-to-actions, move chips left; (5) the player/banker total badges cover the cards, move them up; (6) card faces show the rank three times — both corners plus a third floating glyph over the centre suit. Delivery rules he set: each item its own PR, Codex CLI reviews (not agy, not cursor), merge once Codex agrees. Planning partner dispatched to spec all six and to choose the build order.
